x: Following tea, several members and friends kindly entertained us with songs and recitations, and stump speeches. A popular innovation was the community singing of a few sea chanties led by Mr. Thomson, and we enjoyed entertainment by Miss Fish.
Mr. Thomson stated that the Club were very fortunate in having so many friends in the athletic world who were always ready to assist when required.
I tried to persuade Thomson to milk one. I forget what he said exactly, but there was no doubt that he meant "No." On the other side of the road in the ditch was a broken down car.
We are also especially grateful to Messrs. Askew, Bayliss, Elson, Gordon and Thomson for their support of the Prize Fund, and to Mr.

Askew, Bellfield, Gordon and Thomson for generous donations to the Prize Fund; to Mr. Allen for providing one of the prizes; and to the R.W.A. officials, and the competitors whose annual help and support is much appreciated.

- Ray Middleton finished 3rd in the S.C.A.A.A. 7 miles walk at Battersea in 53.51 behind Thomson and Clark. Ray Hall "out for a quickie" finished 9th in 55:53 with Belderson three minutes down in 17th position.
